scope: M69 candidate5 original events under its frozen actions; observations do not transfer unchanged to a modified plan.
policy: No operator is mandatory. GPT may retain, replace, delete, or reassign any role; selection remains model-made.

operator_rows.name: 芬
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@0 for 10 DP. Early/central blocker for #1/#6/#10/#12/#19/#21/#27/#29/#33; dealt 16,471.25 total including early clears, but only 276.25 to #21 and 195 to #33. No death or retreat.
operator_rows.retention_cost: A deploy slot and early DP; central #21/#33 blocking depended on her survival.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Could be replaced by another blocker/economic opener or the role could be restructured, but early #1/#6 and central #21/#33 windows must have live replacement capacity.

operator_rows.name: Friston-3
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@91 for 3 DP and held many early/officer targets. Blocked #22@4796-6447, #28@5871-6577 and #31@6081-6577. Took 13810 incoming; died@6577 after #28/#31/#34 mixed pressure. Last heals were Hibiscus@6468/Ansel@6534, then Hibiscus healed Fang@6554.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Still holding #28/#31 when killed; death released both.
operator_rows.retention_cost: Very low DP but concentrated late pressure; no #34 damage or BLOCK.
operator_rows.replacement_space: A higher-survivability blocker, split blockers, earlier kills, or a #34/late blocker could replace him. His low cost is not proof that the same single tile must hold this queue.

operator_rows.name: 月见夜
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@571 and dealt 49,155.09 across early/central/officer targets; killed many. Blocked #4/#8/#15/#17/#23/#25/#30. Only 1191 to #28 and 397 to #31 before Friston died; no #34 damage.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Blocked officer#30@6098-6408 and continued damage through late queue.
operator_rows.retention_cost: A deploy slot and skills, but output proved broadly reusable.
operator_rows.replacement_space: A different caster/guard could share or replace output, but late #23/#25/#30 and central #22 pressure need enough mixed damage and BLOCK.

operator_rows.name: 玫兰莎
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@841, blocked/killed #5/#9, destroyed roadblock#4@1966, retreated@2054 with 7 refund; returned@4155 and destroyed roadblock#2@10787. Dealt 25,327.88, including #21@3861.52 and #33@2970.4; no death.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Late damage and final retreat@8101; roadblock#2 release enabled protected #14.
operator_rows.retention_cost: One reusable melee slot, skill timing and return DP; early retreat consumed 7 refund but freed a tile for Spot.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Another high physical output/clearer could replace her, but opening roadblock#4, early #5/#9 and late #21/#33 output must be covered.

operator_rows.name: 安赛尔
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@1321; healed 22,551.2 across Friston/Fang/Midnight/Steward/self/Hibiscus. Healed Friston 7477.4 total, including 362@6534 before his death@6577.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Sustained both central tanks and artillery recipients.
operator_rows.retention_cost: Ranged slot and healing-target competition; probability extra heal is unsupported.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Another healer or defensive structure could replace her, but the plan needs enough effective HPS on Friston during #28/#31/#34 overlap, not merely aggregate healing.

operator_rows.name: 芙蓉
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@1681; healed 18,197.6 across Friston/Ansel/Steward/self/Fang. Healed Friston 5284.4 total, including 372.6@6468, then Fang@6554.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Shared Friston sustain and Fang/Ansel support.
operator_rows.retention_cost: Ranged slot and competing healing priorities; no damage contribution.
operator_rows.replacement_space: Could be replaced or merged with another healer/defender, but C5's late survival depended on at least two effective heal streams.

operator_rows.name: 斑点
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@2341 after Melantha's retreat. Dealt 17000 to five officers, blocked all five, and healed Ansel/self 5052.5. Survived to the end; officer#32 remained blocked@6248-8402.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Holding officer#32 and lower-outer pressure after central casualties.
operator_rows.retention_cost: A melee slot and healing coverage while attacking; physical dodge is unsupported.
operator_rows.replacement_space: A tank/healer or officer killer could replace him, but #16/#18/#24/#26/#32 blocking and lower-lane safety must be covered.

operator_rows.name: 史都华德
operator_rows.observed: Deployed@2071 and dealt 13227.21, killing artillery@4273; retreated@4320 with 9 refund. Returned@6421, killed #33 and dealt only 722.39 to #34 with no BLOCK, then retreated@8100. Also destroyed roadblock#1@11017.
operator_rows.latest_necessary_duty: Returned central output; #34 was not closed. Later roadblock#1 destruction at 11017 did not affect protected #3's earlier safe arrival.
operator_rows.retention_cost: Ranged slot and artillery-focus timing; first deployment occupied pressure-sensitive geometry and suffered heavy shared artillery hits before surviving via heals.
operator_rows.replacement_space: He could be retained for artillery closure, replaced by a stronger/faster artillery-killer, or #34 could receive a separate blocker/output. Not keeping him is permitted if artillery is closed elsewhere.

failure_chain.medical_window: Hibiscus@6382/6468 and Ansel@6448/6534 healed Friston; at@6554 Hibiscus switched to Fang, then Friston died after #34's 340 arts hit.

interpretation: Low total damage does not imply replacement; high output does not imply retention. The reusable facts are timing, pressure, healing competition and route contact. All substitutions require recomputed targeting and path effects.
